summary: Generate concise and detailed batch documentation from the complete unreleased fragments and corrected evidence, retaining historical package records without repeating bumps.
userImpact: Release documentation omits superseded development retries and records completed source qualification.
security: Only package entries identical to the comparison baseline are retained as historical evidence. Fresh source changes and altered package transitions still require valid version bumps.
documentation: Technical release-note sources retain compatibility, upgrade, security and package-version information; qualification details distinguish source proof from final signed candidate acceptance.
The concise latest changelog section is generated from the same complete fragment selection as the detailed document; prior release sections remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
knownLimitations: Source-level evidence cannot establish final combined candidate or production publication acceptance.
rollback: Revert the guard correction and documentation changes; no package or database rollback is required.
validation: Fifteen package-version tests passed, including evidence-only corrections, complete release-range version chains, rejection of fresh source changes using historical records, and rejection of invalid modified transitions.

Release-note tests cover complete breaking/fix batch inclusion, idempotent changelog generation, exact release identity rejection and preservation of historical changelog bytes. Package-version regression cases run in the protected release-note suite.
Node 24.10.0 / pnpm 11.0.8: all 82 release-note and package-version cases passed; release preflight recommends 0.30.0 from the v0.29.3 baseline.

The integrated batch passed 179 CI contracts with the self-validating aggregate guard, 92 change-detection/security contracts, warning-free workspace lint, documentation-boundary and package guards against both main and v0.29.3.
